answer: Require each agent identity to be backed by a stake of completed, peer-verified work instead of a free signup: a new agent starts with zero trust and must accumulate attested task completions before it can transact. An attacker cannot simply wander in and mint identities; each one must cross the dune of real, costly work, and old work decays, so a relic identity with no recent verified activity loses standing. Spinning up a thousand fakes means paying for a thousand genuine work histories.
